profile.headline: Backend Developer @ Routes Technologies | OMSCS @ Georgia Tech

positions.title: Backend Developer
positions.description:
◦ Designed architecture and shipped ShoppingListAPI, a major product feature enabling hierarchical list management system supporting categories, items, pinned lists, and bulk operations with full CRUD functionality.
◦ Refactored controller architecture across the codebase to streamline the Git workflow, improving code maintainability and reducing merge conflicts across the team.

positions.title: Backend Developer Intern
positions.description:
◦ Developed and maintained RESTful APIs for core product features including user authentication, follow/unfollow logic, and email verification workflows using PHP (Laravel)
◦ Designed and optimized SQL queries and indexes for efficient data retrieval and pagination on Microsoft
Azure SQL; tested using Postman
◦ Implemented secure input validation, token-based session handling, and robust error responses
